address: No. 03-27/62, 3F, South Zone, Suzhou Center Plaza, Xinggang Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: This restaurant in a conveniently located shopping mall serves modern Chaozhou dishes alongside live seafood from Guangdong and Cantonese barbecue dishes grilled in-house. The angled luffa with Chaozhou beef balls, fish balls and pork sausage has a bouncy texture and the sweetness of cucumber. The sachima with olive kernels is an exclusive sweet with fluffy egg-fried batter bits. The set menus are great value. Booking recommended at peak times....
